The Acme CLI

Usage: acme-cli [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  project       Manage projects
  run           Run a task in your terminal
  login         Log in to Acme
  logout        Log out of Acme
  whoami        Print info about the current login session
  team          Show the team associated with this user
  settings      Customize appearance & behavior
  diagnostic    Run diagnostic tests
  issue         Create a new issue
  plugins       Install, list and remove plugins
  cache         Inspect or clear the local cache
  deploy        Deploy the current project
  update        Check for and install updates
  integrations  Manage system integrations
  serve         Start a persistent local server
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -v, --verbose...              Increase logging verbosity
      --project <PROJECT>       Open the given project, shorthand for run --project
      --tui                     Use the full-screen interface
      --legacy-ui               Use the old line-based interface [aliases: --classic]
      --beta                    Use the beta engine
      --stable                  Use the stable engine (the default)
  -r, --resume                  Resume the most recent task from this directory
      --resume-id <TASK_ID>     Resume a specific task by ID
      --resume-picker           Interactively select a task to resume from this directory [aliases: --list]
      --remote                  Run this task on a remote runner, shorthand for run --remote
      --repo <REPO>             Repository to use for a remote task, shorthand for run --repo
  -h, --help                    Print help
  -V, --version                 Print version
